title: GLP-1 receptor agonists in weight regulation
abstract: Glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists reduce appetite and delay gastric emptying, acting on hypothalamic receptors to promote weight loss and improve metabolic markers.

title: Melanocortin-4 receptor (MC4R) pathway in appetite control
abstract: MC4R activation in the brain regulates energy balance and food intake. High-affinity agonists at MC4R or leptin receptors reduce hyperphagia and promote weight loss.
